meta.parties: Supramanian Chetty v. Siriwardana Et Al

rules.statement: Claims enforceable under the seizure are eligible for rateable distribution according to section 352 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think, therefore, in the words of Lord Wensleydale in Grey v. Pearson(16 H. L. Cos., at p. 106.), quoted in 16 Bombay, p. 100, that the claims of those execution-creditors who under section 295 are entitled to claim the benefit of a distribution of the fruits of the attachment ought to be treated as falling within the words 'all claims enforceable under the attachment', and substituting section 352 for section 295 and the word 'seizure' for attachment renders the ruling entirely applicable here."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 352 of our Civil Procedure Code is practically the same as section 295 of the Indian Code, and section 238 of our Code the same as section 276 of the Indian Code.
